card.summary: Storage Stellar 2 TB, Storage Cosmic 6 TB, plus a 1 TB special. 20 GB NVMe RAID-1 boot + HDD RAID-6 with NVMe cache, Netherlands.

free_tier.stated: Storage Stellar 2 TB, Storage Cosmic 6 TB, plus a 1 TB special. 20 GB NVMe RAID-1 boot + HDD RAID-6 with NVMe cache, Netherlands.

egress.terms: 'Fair-Use Traffic' with no published number on the storage page. The offer threads give '7,5 TB Traffic per month included' on the 2 TB plan and describe 'Unlimited @ 5Gbps shared' on the 1 TB special. Conflicting, so treat as 7.5 TB metered per 2 TB. Extra TB of HDD quoted at '+2€ (20€ Annually) per additional TB' in LET thread 217568. That marginal rate is the number worth having.

record.chaining: Root KVM virtual server with 2.5 to 5 Gbps uplink. Incremental HDD storage is available at 2 EUR per TB.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: none. Storage Stellar and Cosmic both showed 'Sold Out' / 'Temporarily sold out' when read.
record.reliability_note: Small NL provider, active on LET as a Patron Provider. No data-loss reports surfaced. Sold-out status is persistent across two reads.

evidence.proved: Storage Stellar from €7.50 (2 TB HDD, 20 GB NVMe, 'Fair-Use Traffic', up to 5 Gbit/s), Storage Cosmic from €19.00 (6 TB), both 'Sold Out'
'Just 3,75€/Month or 37,50€/Annually ... +2€ (20€ Annually) per additional TB of HDD Storage'

record.price_per_tb_month: $4.21/TB/mo at 2 TB (€7.50). At 5 TB: €3.50 base (2 TB) + 3 x €2 marginal = €9.50/mo = $10.67 for 5 TB = $2.13/TB — the €2/TB marginal rate is the lowest of the storage providers compared, if the provider will actually build the config. At 20 TB: €3.50 + 18 x €2 = €39.50/mo = $44.37 = $2.22/TB. Sold out.
